Subject: Request: EU-only processing + VPC/HSM & SIG/CAIQ pack

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for the demo last week — Alpine Health is interested in moving to a short procurement window but we need to validate technical and contractual commitments before we can proceed. Our security and procurement teams have a few non-negotiables for this PoC/initial contract: 

- EU-only processing (data at rest and in transit must remain within EU regions; we require contractual commitments and an auditable routing plan)
- VPC connectivity or Private deployment in our VPC (we need a topology diagram and SoW-level detail)
- HSM-backed key control (customer-managed keys preferred; we need an attestation of KMS/HSM integration options)
- Completed SIG and CAIQ questionnaires, and the latest SOC 2 report (redacted is acceptable)

Can you confirm what artifacts you can provide and a realistic timeline? Procurement needs the evidence bundle by 2026-08-20 to make a Q3 decision.

I've attached our internal questionnaire to speed the intake.

Attachments: Alpine_Security_Questionnaire_v2.pdf (PDF, 3 pages)

Thanks,
Maya Singh

Date: 2026-08-02T08:47:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: EU-only processing + VPC/HSM & SIG/CAIQ pack

Vanessa / Rishi — technical notes and timeline below.

1) EU-only processing: feasible on Redwood Private and Dedicated; we route by region and can apply strict routing policies at the load balancer/orchestrator layer. We'll supply a signed routing attestation plus a region-lock configuration snippet for the customer's SRE team.

2) VPC / network topology: we can do (a) dedicated Private deployment inside customer-managed VPC peering, or (b) Private with managed VPC hosted by Redwood inside the EU region. For procurement, the common deliverables are: topology diagram, firewall rules excerpt, peering instructions, and SoW network appendix.

3) HSM / KMS: we support BYOK using customer-managed KMS (AWS KMS / HSM) in eu-west regions. If the customer wants on-prem HSMs, we'll need a short integration plan (usually 2-3 weeks to validate). We can provide a KMS attestation document describing key origin, rotation frequency, and access controls.

4) Artifacts we can deliver within 7 business days: SIG (completed), CAIQ export, SOC 2 Type II (redacted), network topology diagram (SVG/PDF), KMS/HSM attestation, DPIA template.

Estimated timeline: compile artifacts by 2026-08-09; deliver to customer and internal procurement for review 2026-08-10 — gives Alpine a 10-day window before their deadline. If they need DocuSign DPA turnaround faster, we can prioritize.

Marcus
Principal Systems Engineer
Redwood Inference

- VPC options: Private deployment in customer VPC (peering) or Redwood-hosted Private in EU — we've included a topology diagram and sample firewall rules.
- HSM/KMS: BYOK support with customer-managed KMS in eu-west; attestation included outlining key custody model and rotation.
- Artifacts: SIG (spreadsheet), CAIQ export, SOC 2 Type II report (redacted), network topology diagram, KMS/HSM attestation, DPIA template.

Attachments (bundle):

We can also provide a short SCCs/DPA addendum for EU-only routing if you provide procurement's preferred text; otherwise we propose the standard EU SCCs plus routing attestation.

Action items for Alpine: please confirm (a) whether you require customer-managed keys (BYOK) or Redwood-managed keys, (b) the procurement contact for DPA and PO, and (c) if you need the artifacts uploaded to a secure share (we can send a HubSpot-secure link or DocuSign/SharePoint).

Download bundle (secure link will follow once you confirm).

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.
